Language movement veteran Ranesh Maitra no more
2022-09-26T12:14:08+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/language-movement-veteran-ranesh-maitra-no-more-3128431

Language movement veteran Ekushey Padak winning journalist Ranesh Maitra passed away. He was 90.

He breathed his last around 4am today (September 26, 2022) at a Dhaka hospital.

Pankaj Bhattacharya, president of Oikya National Awami Party, confirmed it to The Daily Star.
